proposed_capability: Plan one observed Fairy Dust interaction using current Fairy Home availability, active-Fairy home use, or a direct request to a verified NPC Fairy. Integrate in the existing installed native runtime.
player_save_control_impact: Existing runtime owns player inactivity, save admission, queue, atomic submission, and one-attempt gating. No save, game or desktop effect in fixtures.
expected_outcome: Current enabled Shake, confirmed fairy-only home use, or direct dust ask yields one scoped candidate. Paused game and merely elapsed time cannot make a disabled menu executable. Confirm dust inventory independently.
negative_tests: Elapsed time, disabled or stale Shake, and missing target identity cannot collect.
NPC autonomy and occult conversion are excluded from automation.
No late, unrelated, or uncorrelated response can authorize replay or claim a dust yield.
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature PR or omit the optional Fairy Dust support from the independently built installed ecology package.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact installed EA tuning IDs, accumulation timing and constraints, resource yield, interaction mapping and native outcome producer under issue #171.
